meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求迁移旧记忆时，Claude会检查并搬运旧版NanoClaw和Claude留下的记忆文件（如.seed.md、CLAUDE.md等），把有用的信息整理进共享记忆树并建索引，最后给你一份迁移报告。它不会在正常启动时自动导入旧文件。
howto.when: 触发时机：更新后报告共享记忆不兼容时；或群里仍存在.seed.md、CLAUDE.md、Claude自动记忆等旧文件时；或你说“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等触发词时。

say.text: 把旧的CLAUDE.md迁移到共享记忆里
say.note: Claude会开始检查并搬运这个文件

say.text: 我升级后忘了所有东西，帮我迁移记忆
say.note: Claude会扫描旧记忆并恢复索引

say.text: 处理遗留的.seed.md和自动记忆
say.note: Claude会整理这些旧文件到标准位置

howto.what_en: When asked to run a memory migration, Claude scans and moves legacy memory files (e.g. .seed.md, CLAUDE.md), organizes useful info into the shared memory tree with indexes, and reports. It won't auto-import on normal startup.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports shared-memory breaking change; or when a group still has legacy files like .seed.md, CLAUDE.md, or auto-memory; or when you say 'migrate memory', 'legacy memory', etc.

say_en.text: Migrate the old CLAUDE.md into shared memory.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect and move this file.

say_en.text: I forgot everything after the upgrade, please migrate my memory.
say_en.note: Claude will scan old memories and rebuild the index.

say_en.text: Handle the leftover .seed.md and auto memory.
say_en.note: Claude will organize these legacy files.
